summary.zh: agents-init 的 adopt 预览按实际规则写明备份位置：随 --recovery-dir 变化，缺省时写出默认目录；备份目录在项目内时预览阶段就给出与 apply 相同的拒绝提示。
summary.en: The agents-init adopt preview now names the backup location that apply will really use: it follows --recovery-dir, shows the default folder otherwise, and rejects a backup folder inside the project at preview time like apply does.
